translation:
I think about this a lot, but no matter how you
slice it, you're just way too tyrannical.

Exactly what about me are you claiming is
tyrannical?

Maybe the part where you glare at me for
sharing that opinion, for example.

Well obviously. That's because you just said
something very disagreeable, didn't you?

Calling me "tyrannical” of all things is simply
unthinkable.

I give my absolute everything for the SOS
Brigade and its members, after all.

What kind of bad joke is that? She can't
possibly be serious, right?

After careful consideration, I concluded that
my authority is in everyone's best interest.

If you have any complaints, then tell me
something actually worth listening to.

I'm always trying to present constructive
ideas, though.
Eh, like what?

Let's end the summer camp immediately and go
home.
Rejected.
You never listen to what I have to say!

Out of the question! What an unbecoming
thing for a brigade member to say.

Damn it. Turns out I was right on the mark
about her being tyrannical…
Eh? Tyrannical? Me?
No… Um…

Only one person would dare say such a
thing—Kyon!
Eep…

He's always treating me like some kind of
dictator!

When dealing with the masses, you have to
carefully decide when to use the carrot…

…and when to use the stick. Just oppressing
them simply won't do.

C-could it be that you're interested in
becoming a politician, Suzumiya…?
Nah, not really.

All that talk about budgeting and policies—it
doesn't sound fun at all, does it?

Plus, if I were to disappear, then what would
become of the SOS Brigade?

We need to start seriously ramping up our
reputation from here on out.

We need to turn the tables so that the world's
secrets start arriving at OUR doorstep.

To that end, we'd better get on with it and pin
down the truth behind this case!
Come on, Mikuru! Let me see some enthusiasm!
O-okay…

I have heard about your reputation for being
a tyrant.
I'm a tyrant?
That's rich coming from Kyon.

According to him, I just do whatever I please
with everyone around me, right?
That is how he recognizes it.
Listen up, Yuki.

It's all because of my high-level leadership
skills.

If you think about it, every great leader in
history has been a little misunderstood.

Their actions might seem self-righteous, but
when you look at the bigger picture…
…sometimes it's for the greater good.

In a way, I make decisions based on their
global impact.

I knew he was clueless, but this is just
pathetic.
Kyon is in dire need of some education, huh?
And I'll make it as spartan as possible!

He often expresses his discontent by
referring to you as a tyrant, Miss Suzumiya.

I know Kyon likes to complain like that, but
don't misunderstand me here, Koizumi.

I may appear strict with Kyon, but only
because I'm trying to educate him.
Educate, you say…?

No matter what, he's always looking for
shortcuts to every problem.
He never takes initiative, you know?

At this rate, he'll surely graduate without
even realizing it…

He'll just continue drifting along through the
system without a second thought.

Just when he thinks he's found himself a nice
job, he'll lose out to the harshness of society.

It's my duty to correct his course while I still
can!

I see, so that's all it was. What else should I
have expected from Miss Suzumiya?

When you think about it, Kyon should be
thanking me for my efforts!
